dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Maybe they dream of becoming giant volcano dragons and soaring among the clouds...

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Or, maybe they dream of a mountain of cabbages! Tatankasaurs are very fond of cabbages!

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Hehe, but honestly, I have no idea. I just think it's fun to imagine.
